records.question: What is the approved sales quantity in base cups?
records.final_sql: SELECT SUM(s.qty * CASE WHEN s.unit = 'box' THEN m.units_per_box ELSE 1 END) AS n FROM sales s JOIN materials m USING(material_id) WHERE s.status='approved'

records.question: What is the posted stock-out quantity in base cups, including waste?
records.final_sql: SELECT SUM(o.qty * CASE WHEN o.unit = 'box' THEN m.units_per_box ELSE 1 END) AS n FROM stock_out o JOIN materials m USING(material_id) WHERE o.status='posted'

records.question: How many distinct approved sales documents are there?
records.final_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_code) AS n FROM sales WHERE status='approved'

records.question: How many approved sales-return document lines are there?
records.final_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM sales_returns WHERE status='C'

records.question: What is the approved refund total in CNY excluding tax, expressed as a positive amount?
records.final_sql: SELECT SUM(ABS(refund_net)) AS n FROM sales_returns WHERE status='C'

records.question: How many base cups were returned on approved sales returns, expressed as a positive quantity?
records.final_sql: SELECT SUM(ABS(r.qty)*CASE WHEN r.unit='box' THEN m.units_per_box ELSE 1 END) AS n FROM sales_returns r JOIN materials m USING(material_id) WHERE r.status='C'

records.question: How many base cups physically entered inventory from posted purchases, counting each movement once?
records.final_sql:
WITH unique_in AS (
  SELECT i.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY movement_key ORDER BY row_id) AS rn
  FROM stock_in i
) SELECT SUM(i.qty * CASE WHEN i.unit = 'box' THEN m.units_per_box ELSE 1 END) AS n FROM unique_in i JOIN materials m USING(material_id) WHERE rn=1 AND status='posted' AND source_type='purchase'

records.question: How many extra stock-in export rows are replays of an existing movement?
records.final_sql: SELECT COUNT(*)-COUNT(DISTINCT movement_key) AS n FROM stock_in

records.question: What is the tax-inclusive total value of approved sales orders in CNY?
records.final_sql: SELECT SUM(line_tax_amount) AS n FROM sales WHERE status='approved'

records.question: What is the largest approved sales order's tax-inclusive total in CNY? Return only the amount.
records.final_sql: SELECT MAX(order_total) AS n FROM sales WHERE status='approved'

records.question: How many base cups physically entered inventory from completed production? Count each physical receipt once.
records.final_sql: SELECT SUM(p.qty * CASE WHEN p.unit = 'box' THEN m.units_per_box ELSE 1 END) AS n FROM production_receipts p JOIN materials m USING(material_id) WHERE status='completed'

records.question: What is the total physical inventory inflow in base cups from all posted sources, including production and returns? Count each movement once.
records.final_sql:
WITH unique_in AS (
  SELECT i.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY movement_key ORDER BY row_id) AS rn
  FROM stock_in i
) SELECT SUM(i.qty * CASE WHEN i.unit = 'box' THEN m.units_per_box ELSE 1 END) AS n FROM unique_in i JOIN materials m USING(material_id) WHERE rn=1 AND status='posted'

records.question: What is the highest valid measured stock-out weight in kg across all export rows?
records.final_sql: SELECT MAX(CAST(weight_text AS DECIMAL(18,4))) AS n FROM stock_out WHERE weight_text REGEXP '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$'

records.question: What is the average valid measured stock-out weight in kg across all export rows, excluding unavailable readings? Round to 4 decimal places.
records.final_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(CAST(weight_text AS DECIMAL(18,4))),4) AS n FROM stock_out WHERE weight_text REGEXP '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$'

records.question: How many stock-in export rows are posted? This is a raw-row diagnostic; include replay rows.
records.final_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM stock_in WHERE status='posted'

records.question: How many stock-in export rows are not posted? This is a raw-row diagnostic; include replay rows.
records.final_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM stock_in WHERE status<>'posted'

records.question: How many material master records are there?
records.final_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM materials

records.question: How many warehouses are in the warehouse master?
records.final_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM warehouses

records.question: How many customer stores are in the customer master?
records.final_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers

records.question: As of 2026-09-19, what is inventory on hand in base cups across all warehouses? Opening inventory before these documents was zero.
records.final_sql:
WITH unique_in AS (
  SELECT i.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY movement_key ORDER BY row_id) AS rn
  FROM stock_in i
) SELECT (SELECT SUM(i.qty * CASE WHEN i.unit = 'box' THEN m.units_per_box ELSE 1 END) FROM unique_in i JOIN materials m USING(material_id) WHERE rn=1 AND status='posted') - (SELECT SUM(o.qty * CASE WHEN o.unit = 'box' THEN m.units_per_box ELSE 1 END) FROM stock_out o JOIN materials m USING(material_id) WHERE status='posted') AS n
